description: Search the College Scorecard field catalog by keyword. Returns matching field paths, descriptions, data types, and whether each field supports API-side sorting. Use before passing custom field paths to the fields parameter on scorecard_get_school to find a supported path. Served entirely from embedded static data — no API call, no rate limit impact.

limit.description: Requested limit; serving cap 100, hard ceiling 1,000.

query.description: Keyword to search the field catalog (e.g. "tuition", "earnings", "admissions", "debt"). Matches against field paths, descriptions, and category names.

name: scorecard_list_fields

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Concrete narrowing guidance when matches remain.

results.description: Matching field entries ranked by relevance.

category.description: Thematic category (e.g. cost, admissions, earnings, programs).

sortable.description: Whether this field supports API-side sort parameter.

type.description: Data type: integer, float, string, or boolean.

tip.description: Usage tip for unsortable fields when relevant.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit.

title: List Scorecard Fields
